observations: Photo 0 shows a green and yellow handheld power tool with a black cord and plug, placed next to a rectangular green power unit with ventilation slots and a metal handle.
Photo 1 shows the same setup from a different angle, with the power unit on a white surface against a grey brick wall background.
The handheld tool has a yellow grip, a black body, and a small label with text and symbols, but the brand and model are not legible.
The power unit has a small digital display, a power switch, and a coiled black cable with a green tie.
The tool appears to be a drill or router, with a chuck at the end.
The photos are watermarked with 'UKACHUKWU JUDE POSTED ON JIJI' and a phone watermark 'itel S18 4G'.
